user.title: Connect to PentagonHub
user.description: Enter the PentagonHub Core API URL reachable from this Home Assistant instance.

data_description.api_base_url: For local development this may be a LAN URL such as http://192.168.1.20:3100/api.
data_description.ha_base_url: Optional. This is shown in PentagonHub Center as the HA base URL.

approve.title: Approve in PentagonHub Center
approve.description: Open {verification_uri_complete} and approve this Home Assistant instance. Pairing code: {user_code}. The code expires in {expires_in} seconds. After approving, select Submit here.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect PentagonHub
reauth_confirm.description: PentagonHub will create a new pairing code and replace the stored installation token.

error.authorization_pending: The pairing request is not approved yet. Approve it in PentagonHub Center, then submit again.
error.invalid_response: PentagonHub Core returned an unexpected response.

abort.pairing_expired: The pairing code expired. Start pairing again.
abort.pairing_rejected: The pairing request was rejected in PentagonHub Center.

data_description.heartbeat_interval: Seconds between heartbeat requests to PentagonHub Core.
